title: Loved our guided Gibraltar visit from Seville
text: This summer (2026) Spain and the UK eliminated physical border security checks for Gibraltar, making it much easier to visit the famous Rock / Peñón. Our party of 5 seniors (66-80) left Sevilla with our fantastic Sevilla Moving driver and guide, Miguel, at 8am on a Wednesday in September, reaching the airport parking lot in Gibraltar at approximately 10:30am. There, our friendly and informative local guide, Justin, took us up to the top, stopping at all the interesting points to get out for pictures and exploring. title: The guide, Francisco, was...
text: The guide, Francisco, was terrific. He took excellent care of us. We felt Gibraltar was underwhelming & a little tricky (and exhausting) to get down. But to be fair, we didn’t do the cave, the tunnels, the apes den. We just wanted to get down! Would definitely recommend taking the cable car back down.
author: Nancy_N
